question:
The following pie chart reflects the total percentage of marks of 5 boys in an exam. The total marks for these boys in this the exam is 800. The marks of Rohit is how much percentage less than that of Raju ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e5aa6bff23101c82d254fa9651f817439cac6786c43719cadbb3a55ce07a292.png]
solution:
Calculation:

Rohit and Raju scored 15% and 20% of the total marks respectively.

Now, the required % = frac {20 - 15}{20} times 100\% = 25%

**∴ The marks of Rohit is 25% less than that of Raju.**
